newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union plans Czech subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union plans Czech subsidiary.

text.p: Insurance company Commercial Union Plc said on Monday it had been granted a licence to operate in the Czech Republic.
The company said in a statement its Czech subsidiary, Commercial Union zivotni pojistovna a.s., would be based in Prague and was expected to be fully operational by the end of this year.
Commercial Union was the largest overseas life assurance company in Poland, where it established a presence in 1992, said the statement.
"This development extends our presence in Eastern Europe...following our success in Poland," said Roy Kemp, general manager Europe division.
Commercial Union was looking at other opportunities in Eastern Europe, including Russia, the statement said.
